description:
## Problem
`docs/internal/adr/adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md` and `docs/internal/adr/adr-independent-publication-authorities.md` split corpus authority across `published-results` (accepted archive) and `develop` (Explorer input via `scripts/site_inputs.py`), with no promotion path or owner after `adr-site-repo-split.md` D12 retired the publication manifest control plane. As of 2026-11-24, `results-data/` holds 22.3 MB and 470 maintainer-run bundles (0 community submissions), yet core maintains mirror workflows, two drift checks, manual two-step withdrawals, and a stale `publication/ledger-seed.json`.

## Change
Write and merge a new ADR under `docs/internal/adr/` recording the owner's 2026-11-24 approval of amended Option 1:
1. Declare `develop:results-data/` as the single accepted corpus archive and sole `scripts/site_inputs.py` / Explorer source.
2. Supersede the separate `published-results` archive and manifest clauses of `adr-published-results-slim-corpus-branch.md` and `adr-independent-publication-authorities.md`, adding reciprocal dated supersession headers to both older ADRs.
3. Preserve surviving invariants verbatim in the contract: acceptance is distinct from deployed observation; community submissions require manual review and must never auto-merge; accepted bytes are never purged.
4. Record the mandatory cutover order: move intake to `develop` (Step 2) and ship `benchbox submit` targeting `develop` (Step 3) + site docs on `next` (Step 4) before retiring mirror/drift machinery and freezing `published-results` read-only without deleting its history (Step 5).

## Decision gates
- Do not change code, workflows, or `tests/unit/docs/test_publication_architecture.py` in this ADR-only PR (if `test_publication_architecture.py` asserts phrases in `adr-independent-publication-authorities.md`, keep those historical body paragraphs intact and add a top-level dated supersession banner so the test stays green until Step 2 rewrites it).
- Do not touch active batch `corpus-rule-r4` (`crr-a5-published-results-mirror`) or close PR #4481 without explicit owner confirmation.
- Any deviation from the surviving invariants (manual review, no auto-merge, no purge, freeze-not-delete) stops for owner approval.

## Verification rubric
- Pass: new ADR and reciprocal supersession headers exist on `develop`; `tests/unit/docs/test_publication_architecture.py`, `make docs-reference-inventory-check`, `make pr-preflight`, and hosted `review-gate` all pass on the merged head.
- Fail: edits rewrite historical body text of the superseded ADRs, weaken surviving invariants, or leave one-sided supersession links.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit with the pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution or session/plan labels (`[DURABLE-ARTIFACTS-001]`). Run heavy checks only through `make pr-preflight` or `make heavy-run`; never skip `~/.benchbox/test.lock` or bypass admission/watchdog. Never use `--no-verify`, force-push, or stand-in reviews. Open with `make pr-open`, arm with `make pr-arm`, and resolve review threads only after the bot's review of the new head passes.
